title: Ƙare shi daidai: kullin likitan fiɗa da kullin mataki biyu
course_title: Yin Ƙwaƙwalwar Ƙwaƙwalwa & Sana'o'i Masu Sauƙi

say: Ƙare shi daidai: kullin likitan fiɗa da kullin mataki biyu.
This is the video for module two of Bead Making and Simple Crafts: guided practice with bracelets, necklaces and bead bags.

A cikin beadwork, ƙare yana yanke shawarar ingancin. Yawancin mundayen mundaye na gida suna karye saboda igiyar ba a riga an miƙe ta ba, kullin ba daidai ba ne, ko kullin ya zauna a gefen ƙulli mai kaifi.

say: Kawo ƙarshen ƙarshen baya ta cikin bututu, don haka duka wayoyi suna kwance gefe da gefe. Bar wutsiya mai kusan 3 cm da ƙarami, madauki maras kyau a kusa da rungumar.

say: Sanya bututun a baya na ƙwanƙwasa, wanda ke da tsoma, mafi kusa da rike. Duba ba a ketare wayoyi ba, kuma a matse. Yanzu akwai tsagi.

say: Juya bututun kwata kwata, sanya shi a gaban gaba, zagaye na gaba, sannan a matse shi don ninka shi cikin rabi.

say: Kafin ka murƙushe ƙarshen na biyu, riƙe abin wuya sama a cikin lanƙwasa. Bar sauƙi kaɗan, game da faɗin rabin dutsen dutse, don haka ya yi laushi a hankali. Buɗe zoben tsalle ta karkatar da gefe ɗaya zuwa gare ku ɗaya kuma nesa. Kuma sanya dunƙule mai santsi a kowane gefen kristal mai kaifi.

right: Janye wayar da ƙarfi kamar bangle

say: Kar a ja wayar sosai har abin wuya ya tsaya tsayin daka kamar bangle. Kada a buɗe zoben zuwa siffar C, wanda ke raunana ƙarfe. Kuma kada ku bari na roba ya shafa akan rami mai kaifi.

say: Don tunawa. Pre-miƙe na roba. Kullin Likitan tiyata: dama akan hagu sau biyu, hagu akan dama sau ɗaya. Yanke cikin matakai biyu, baya baya sannan daraja ta gaba, kuma a gwada kowane crimp. Bar sauƙi. Kuma koyaushe ku saƙa filin gwaji kafin ku tsara jaka.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Pre-miƙe na roba kafin kirtani
Dama akan hagu sau biyu, hagu akan dama sau daya
Matsayin baya, daraja ta gaba, sannan gwadawa
Bar sauƙi kaɗan don labule mai laushi
Gwada murabba'i kafin shirya jaka

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Yi mundaye masu shimfiɗa biyu kuma kwatanta su bayan kwana biyar. Yi crimps guda biyar akan waya mai yatsa. Yi abin wuya na gimbiya tare da 'yan kunne masu dacewa. Kuma a saƙa filin gwaji, sannan a saƙa.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Mundaye guda biyu: ɗaya an riga an miƙe, ɗaya ba
Guda biyar motsa jiki, ja kowanne
Gimbiya abun wuya da 'yan kunne masu dacewa
A 5 ta 5 murabba'in gwaji da kuma bakin teku
